{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check if there are any commas in the revenue strings
column_has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f'Are there commas in revenue values? {column_has_commas}')

# If yes, strip commas and convert to float
def parse_revenue(revenue_str):
    return float(revenue_str.replace(',', ''))

# Apply parsing
df['revenue_parsed'] = df['revenue'].apply(parse_revenue)

# Confirm parsing worked
print(f'First 5 parsed revenues: {df["revenue_parsed"].head().tolist()}')"}
